text:
maddie: Heads-up — I ran into a deploybot pin this morning when rolling out the quant-v4b model to eu-west. We triggered an adaptive-pin because the runtime kernel mismatch metric spiked. Can ops/devs confirm whether the new 'sentinel' heuristic is intended to pin in that case?

kevin: ack. Which metric exactly spiked? we added a sentinel heuristic that watches for kernel-incompat and high tail-latency correlation. should only pin if both cross thresholds for >=1m.

maddie: Deploybot note said: `kernel_incompat_ratio: 0.42, tail_p95_latency_delta: +34%` — looked like both were over threshold for ~70s.

deploybot: [automated] pinned runtime 2.14.1 -> hold for 1h due to compatibility-sentinel(ks:0.42, p95:+34%).

tara: hmm. That threshold combo was meant for longseq models only. quant-v4b has known cold-kv miss behavior, but it shouldn't soft-pin unless we also see model-fallbacks > 5/min. did you see any fallback count? @maddie

maddie: fallback count was 0 in the short window. Only heavy p95 + kernel_incompat.

jon: this sounds like a false-positive from the sentinel. The heuristic currently doesn't check `model_type in ['longseq', 'dialog']` — I thought we gated that. Looking at the rule set now.

jon: quick snippet from the rule engine:
```
# current sentinel rule (simplified)
if kernel_incompat_ratio > 0.35 and p95_delta_pct > 30:
    trigger_pin(reason='compat-sentinel')
```

kevin: oh dang — we did a rollback of the gating branch last sprint and the model-type guard didn't make it back in. I can patch to add `and model_class == 'longseq'`.

tara: +1 to patching, but also we should consider adaptive-fallback routing instead of immediate pin for non-longseq. e.g., route suspect traffic to runtime-stable pool for 5m, gather more telemetry, then decide.

maddie: agree. For customer-facing production traffic, sudden pin causes capacity churn and unexpected latency regressions for other models.

jon: proposed change (to deploybot rules):
```
if kernel_incompat_ratio > 0.35 and p95_delta_pct > 30:
    if model_class in ['longseq','dialog']:
        trigger_pin()
    else:
        bump_routing_to('stable-pool', duration='5m')
        continue_monitoring(window='5m')
```

deploybot: [automated] created rollout-note: "adaptive-pin-rule-update" — PR #8342 (jon). Will schedule for canary if approved.

kevin: FYI — there's also a separate SDK compatibility signal that fires when client-side tokenization mismatches are seen. We need to AND that signal only when SDK >= 2.7 is in play. Otherwise those tokenization mismatches will incorrectly influence runtime pins.

maddie: good catch. We saw a spike in tokenization-mismatch logs coming from an internal staging job that still uses SDK 2.6.

tara: suggested followups:
- patch sentinel rule to add model_class gating (jon)
- add SDK-version guard to tokenization signal (kevin)
- implement 'stable-pool routing' fallback (ops)
- add changelog entry + postmortem template fields for pin events (maddie/tara)

jon: I'll open the PR for gating and add unit tests for model_class cases. target: canary window tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

kevin: i'll add the SDK guard and a short feature-flag to flip it on for 2.7+. will coordinate with @ops for rollout.

ops: noted — will prep stable-pool (capacity + autoscale limits) and update routing policy. ops-runbook: ensure we have a pin-unwind automation if we see regressions.

maddie: can we get a short deploybot query that folks can run to surface current pins and their triggers? wrote this quick one:
```
# deploybot-pin query
GET /deploybot/v1/pins?region=eu-west&since=2h
# response fields: runtime, model, reason, metrics_snapshot
```

deploybot: [automated] sample output (redacted):
- runtime: 2.14.1, model: quant-v4b, reason: compat-sentinel, kernel_incompat_ratio:0.42, p95:+34%, sdk_version:2.6

tara: OK. Schedule for canary if jon's PR lands and kevin's SDK guard is in. maddie — please file the changelog note and tag `release-coord` so PMs are aware.

maddie: done. created changelog entry "adaptive-pin: model_class guard + stable-pool fallback" and linked PRs. tagging #release-coord.

jon: PR #8342 merged to canary. deploybot will run the updated rules in canary tonight.

deploybot: [automated] canary-run scheduled 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Will report results in this thread.

maddie: thanks everyone. After canary, let's reconvene if any unexpected pin/unpin oscillations show up. :thumbsup: 

kevin: +1. also adding a quick alert to notify on 'pin-churn > 3 per 30m' to avoid thrash.

ops: noted — will add the alert and hang a temporary mute window for customer-notification during canary.

sre-bot: [automated incident note] created: INC-2026-1197 (monitoring config change for pin-churn alert).

maddie: closing the loop — canary ran, observed stable-pool reroutes handled the spike and no further pins were applied. tagging as resolved but leaving followup card for telemetry improvements.

jon: awesome. followup card: "pin-sentinel-telemetry-enhancements" created in board infra-ops.
